extracted.intended_audience: authors, researchers, journal editors and peer reviewers reporting randomized (clinical) trials
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing complete, transparent reports of randomized (clinical) trial manuscripts, including use of the CONSORT 2025 checklist and relevant CONSORT extensions. Intended to be applied to whole trial reports and to guide authors, editors, and peer reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting of randomised trials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CONSORT 2025 Statement is an updated guideline provided for reporting randomized trials. Use the CONSORT 2025 Checklist (downloadable from the CONSORT-SPIRIT website) when preparing trial reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT 2025 Checklist
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should use the CONSORT 2025 checklist to structure and ensure completeness of the whole trial report. The checklist is the primary tool referenced by the guideline and is intended to be applied to the entire report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Explanation and Elaboration paper
rubrics_metrics.description: CONSORT 2025 explanation and elaboration: updated guideline for reporting randomised trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the accompanying explanation and elaboration paper (Hopewell et al.) for detailed rationale, examples and clarification of checklist items to support correct application of CONSORT items in manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply relevant CONSORT extensions where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Use CONSORT extensions for specialised trial types or reporting needs (e.g., harms, non-inferiority, cluster, abstracts, pragmatic trials, AI interventions, outcomes reporting, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a trial falls into a specialised category, authors should apply the corresponding CONSORT extension in addition to the main CONSORT checklist. Examples listed on the page include CONSORT Harms (2022), CONSORT Non-inferiority (extension), CONSORT Cluster, CONSORT Abstracts, CONSORT Pragmatic Trials, STRICTA (acupuncture), CONSORT PRO (patient-reported outcomes), CENT (N-of-1), CONSORT-AI, CONSORT-ROUTINE, CONSORT-Outcomes, CONSORT-DEFINE (dose-finding), Factorial, CONSORT-Surrogate, CONSORT-iNeurostim, CONSORT CRXO (cluster randomised crossover), and others. The page provides bibliographic references for each extension and indicates that these extensions contain extension-specific checklists and explanations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study design applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Study design: Clinical trials, Experimental studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT 2025 is intended for randomized (clinical) trials and experimental studies; authors should confirm that their study design falls within this scope before applying the checklist and any extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applies to the whole report
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline/checklist is designed to be applied across the entire manuscript (title/abstract/introduction/methods/results/discussion) rather than to isolated sections only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use SPIRIT for trial protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for developing protocols for clinical trials is provided in the SPIRIT 2013 Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For trial protocol development (as opposed to trial reporting), authors should consult SPIRIT 2013. The CONSORT page links to SPIRIT for protocol-specific guidance to ensure alignment between protocol content and eventual reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextualisation for specific fields (e.g., deprescribing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contextualisation guidance for using the CONSORT guideline to report deprescribing trials has been developed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where particular clinical contexts or intervention types require adaptation (for example, deprescribing trials), authors should consult contextualisation or elaboration documents developed for those fields to ensure appropriate reporting nuances are captured.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult translations when needed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT (previous versions such as 2010) has translations into many languages (Chinese, French, German, Greek, Italian, Japanese, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish). Users who require non‑English versions should consult the translations page to find appropriate language resources.
